description:
Annapurna Labs is a fabless semiconductor company founded by industry veterans. We develop leading-edge products on state-of-the-art process technologies, and we're looking for talented engineers to help us build a semiconductor platform based on a revolutionary architecture.

You'll help develop state-of-the-art products within a disruptive system architecture, working on the technologies that power the world's largest cloud provider in a dynamic, open and fast-paced environment. AWS provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost cloud infrastructure platform that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries.

You'll join the SoC Power Analysis team on the Graviton and Nitro product line. The team owns the full process of Power Analysis from architecture stages till post Si, including Arch definition and Si configuration of Power Management features.. We work closely with product definition, pre- and post-silicon validation, physical design, software and other teams across the full chip development cycle, from idea to mass production. Your work will impact the efficiency of chips in AWS data centers worldwide, and hence will have large-scale impact.

At Annapurna Labs, you'll play a key role in developing the next generation of semiconductor platforms for the world's largest cloud infrastructure, and in shaping the future of cloud computing.

Watch these videos to learn more about Annapurna Labs and the Graviton project:

AWS re:Invent 2025 - Keynote with Peter DeSantis and Dave Brown: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JeUpUK0nhC0

AWS re:Invent 2025 - AWS Graviton: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=haSHl2BLhm8

Key job responsibilities

- Analyze SoC Power consumption at Pre and Post Si stages

- Contribute to SoC Power optimization during all stages of Design Cycle

- Work with variety of teams to impact the quality of SoC power efficiency: Logic & Physical Design, PDN, Post-Si.

- Optimize Power Team analysis processes to raise effectiveness of our work.

- Solve challenging problems on a daily basis.

A day in the life

- Work on state-of-the-art processor technology

- Engage in the complete chip development cycle, from initial architecture through post-silicon analysis

- Solve complex, multidisciplinary challenges

- Collaborate with talented teams across the organization

- Contribute directly to next-generation cloud computing solutions

Basic qualifications
- BSc in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering

- Strong problem solving skills

- Ability to handle multidisciplinary tasks that require knowledge in different chip design domains, and to work in a rapidly changing environment.

Preferred qualifications
- Previous experience (including academic projects or internships) in the following domains: Power analysis and optimization, Logic design, Backend design, Chip Verification.

- Familiarity with power analysis tools such as PrimeTime/PrimePower, PowerArtist, or Voltus

- Proficiency in one or more of the following programming languages: C, Python, Tcl.

- Strong communication skills and ability to effectively communicate and cooperate with other teams to complete tasks.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Bonus points if you have:

- Experience with Java or other object-oriented languages (C#, Kotlin, C++ or similar)

- Experience building AI agents, MCP servers, custom skills or automated workflows on top of AI coding tools

- Full-stack experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, React, HTML and CSS

- Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases (MySQL, Vertica, Cassandra)

- Exposure to large-scale distributed systems, Kafka, Docker or Kubernetes

- Experience with big data tools (Spark, BigQuery, Airflow)

- Graduated with honors

How you'll make an impact:

- Work AI-first: use AI coding agents every day to plan, code, test, review and debug, often running several agents in parallel on different tasks

- Build AI agents, skills and workflows that multiply the team's capabilities, such as automated code reviews, data analysis, production investigation and feature validation

- Develop at unimaginable scale, serving thousands of requests per second

- Influence directly on the way billions of people discover the internet

- Collaborate closely with the brightest engineers, product managers and business teams

- Work on innovative projects that are the next growth engines for Taboola

Why Taboola?

If you ask Taboolars what they love about working here, they’ll tell you that they’ve been empowered to realize their full potential while growing and learning from and with smart and talented people. They’ll also share more about:

- Adam Singolda, Taboola Founder and CEO says; “You can copy anything from another business but you can’t copy a company’s culture.

Ready to realize your potential?

Scope before you commit. Analyze what's technically and economically possible, tell us honestly what a capability will cost to run, and say when something shouldn't be built at all.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

The following duties are normal for this position.

These are not to be construed as exclusive or all-inclusive.

Other duties may be required and assigned.

Repairs, replaces, and maintains street signs and markers.

Performs manual labor in the repair and construction of streets; performs concrete work, chip seal, asphalt work, and patching on streets, sidewalks, curbs, trails, and parking lots.

Operates painting equipment to paint crosswalks, parking spaces, curbs, and other street and sidewalk markings.

Performs routine maintenance and repairs on equipment.

Mows weeds, cuts brush, trims trees, and cleans site by raking and/or hauling materials; clears storm drains of debris.

Clears snow from

City properties and sidewalks, snowplows streets, and hauls snow off site.

Operates trucks, tractors, mowers, posthole diggers, and other motorized equipment customarily used in the operation and maintenance of streets and facilities, and both motorized and non-motorized equipment.

Assists in general building and grounds cleaning and equipment maintenance work, maintains street shop.

Additional Tasks And Responsibilities

While the following tasks are necessary for the work of the unit, they are not an essential part of the purpose of this position and may also be performed by other unit members.

Helps install and remove snow fence and holiday decorations.

Attends safety meetings and seminars as required.

Assists other departments parks, cemetery, and wastewater as required.

Performs other duties as assigned or apparent.

Qualifications

Minimum Education or Experience Required: High school education or G.E.D., and six to twelve months related experience or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Preferred Education or Experience Required: High school diploma or G.E.D., or twelve months to two years related experience or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Other Requirements – Certificates/Licensures:

Valid Iowa Driver’s License and Commercial Driver’s license (CDL), with air brake endorsement issued by the State of Iowa (within allotted time after hire).

Meets City residency requirements.

About this role

הצטרפו לחטיבת מערכות טילים וחלל בחזית הטכנולוגיה, בתפקיד מרתק כמהנדס/ת פיתוח אלגוריתמי עיבוד אות ותקשורת.

אנו מחפשים כישרונות להוביל פיתוחים חדשניים שיעצבו את עתיד המערכות המורכבות שלנו.

התפקיד כולל פיתוח אלגוריתמים מתקדמים עבור מערכות מורכבות ופורצות דרך, משלבי בדיקת היתכנות ומחקר ועד ל-fixed point design ותמיכה מלאה בתהליכי מימוש ובדיקות מעבדה.

תעבדו בצוות פיתוח מנוסה, בעל ידע מקצועי עמוק ורחב, בסביבה טכנולוגית מאתגרת ומתקדמת.

תחומי האחריות:

פיתוח אלגוריתמים מתקדמים לעיבוד אות ותקשורת.

כתיבת מודלים וסימולציות מורכבות באמצעות
Matlab/Python
.

הובלת תהליכי פיתוח משלב האפיון הראשוני והמחקר.

מתן תמיכה טכנית למימוש אלגוריתמים בסביבות
FPGA/SW
.

זו הזדמנות ייחודית לצמוח מקצועית בסביבה דינמית, להשפיע באופן משמעותי על פרויקטים לאומיים ולקחת חלק בצוות מוביל וחדשני.

Requirements:

אנו מחפשים מועמד/ת בעל/ת יכולות טכניות גבוהות ומוטיבציה להצטרף לצוות הפיתוח שלנו.

הדרישות הבאות הינן חובה:

תואר שני בהנדסת חשמל
- הכרחי להבנת העקרונות התאורטיים והמעשיים הנדרשים לתפקיד.

ניסיון מקצועי של שנתיים לפחות
בפיתוח אלגוריתמי עיבוד אות ותקשורת, כולל הבנה מעמיקה של מתודולוגיות פיתוח.

מוטיבציה גבוהה
ללמידה מתמדת וליזום פתרונות יצירתיים, יחד עם יחסי אנוש מעולים לעבודה שיתופית בצוות.
